translatorNotes: Register: informal tú, consistent with Phase 1.

'no shows' -> 'ausencias' (also common: 'inasistencias' — used once in a secondary keyword). 'front desk' -> 'recepción'. 'intake' -> 'registro' (patient intake). 'provider' (clinician) -> 'profesional'. 'practice' -> 'consulta'; 'clinic' -> 'clínica'.

'EHR' rendered as 'historial' / 'historial clínico' in prose and 'Sistemas de historial clínico' in the tech marquee. Native reviewer may prefer 'HCE' (historia clínica electrónica) for a Spain/LatAm medical audience — FLAG.

'HIPAA', 'BAA', 'PHI' kept as acronyms (US healthcare-privacy framework). PHI glossed once as 'información médica protegida (PHI)'. For a non-US audience these frameworks differ (e.g. GDPR/RGPD, LOPDGDD in Spain) — FLAG for the reviewer to localize the compliance framing.
Prices: '$1,000 and $5,000' -> '1.000 y 5.000 dólares'; '$50 to $300' -> '50 a 300 dólares' (figures unchanged, currency named). '25 to 38 percent' -> 'entre un 25 y un 38 por ciento'.
Brand names (Twilio, WhatsApp Business, n8n, Make, Calendly, Google Workspace) unchanged.
Blog 'related reading' links point to English blog posts (Phase 3 not started); anchor text translated. Nav/footer service + industry links point to /es. Case-studies/about/contact still English.
